discovery.auth: none for REST; MCP needs credentials from TREFA support

reference.verdict: Audit 2026-09-25: verdict **official_mcp** (confidence high). Autos TREFA documents a public unauthenticated REST inventory API (/api/public/inventory, /{slug}, /search, /stats) plus an official stdio MCP server (trefa-mcp-server) for AI assistants.

official_mcp.name: trefa-mcp-server
official_mcp.note: Official stdio server documented at https://autostrefa.mx/documentacion (18 tools: buscar_vehiculos, obtener_vehiculo, comparar_vehiculos, financing...); needs Supabase URL/anon key from dev@trefa.mx. The public REST inventory API is also served here.

adapter.terms: Public read-only inventory API (no key); TREFA asks for at most 100 requests/minute per IP and honouring Cache-Control. Prices in MXN.

search_listings.note: GET /api/public/inventory (documented base https://trefa.mx/api/public, which now 301-redirects to autostrefa.mx) with marca, modelo, ano_min/ano_max, precio_min/precio_max (MXN), km_max, ubicacion (branch), page, per_page ≤ 100. Free text search is a separate endpoint (/inventory/search?q=) and `query` is not used here. The documented example names the year field `ano`; live rows carry `año`, which is what is mapped.

get_listing.note: GET /api/public/inventory/{slug or numeric id}: full vehicle (specs, prices and offers, image gallery, warranty and invoice info, financing estimates).

not_offered.decode_vin: No VIN endpoint in the public API.
not_offered.get_valuation: No valuation endpoint (the MCP server's financing calculator is not a valuation).
not_offered.list_dealers: TREFA is a single retailer; /inventory/stats aggregates the inventory but lists no dealers.
not_offered.me: The public API has no authentication or account.
